params.prompt: Graphic novel inked illustration, painted tableau, a frozen moment. An elder in a hooded cloak stands with his back to the camera before a large fearful crowd of desert-robed people, hands raised in pleading, a striped serpent coiled on the sand between them and a distant line of tents beneath red cliffs. The camera performs a slow push-in toward the elder and the raised pleading hands. Nothing moves -- every face, hand, and the serpent stay fixed as drawn. No invented motion, no morphing, no new elements, no camera shake. Painted tableau stays still; only the camera moves.
